messages:
lina: Heads-up 1: recruiters reported that 12 interviews this morning show scorecard fields but the "culture" section is missing in the UI.

omar: hmm could be the recent schema change where we renamed culture->team-fit. backend saved it but UI mapping dropped it. seeing 200 OKs from API but null in front-end.

priya: are candidate responses lost or just hidden? that's important for HMs.

lina: likely hidden; the payload in GH has team_fit populated. we should avoid any backfill that rewrites fields until UI fix.

omar: plan: 1) small export of affected interviews; 2) dry-run of a metadata-only backfill that sets a ui_flag so the frontend will render team-fit under "culture" temporarily; 3) schedule a 20m interviewer refresher about where to find team-fit in the meantime.

priya: ok for the UI-flag approach. can you post the export CSV first? I'll validate with a random sample.

recruiting-bot: export job queued (ex-114455). ETA ~45s.

omar: export done: 12 rows. sample: INT-3011 candidate C-701 team_fit=4, culture=

priya: sample looks good. proceed with a dry-run. please ensure the backfill only writes ui_flag when culture is empty and team_fit present.

omar: dry-run command:
```
python tools/ats_ui_backfill.py --csv /tmp/ui_missing.csv --dry-run --set ui_flag=teamfit_visible
```

omarr: dry-run: 12 rows would be flagged. no overwrites.

priya: approved. after apply, please post the CSV of updated ids and ping #people-ops. also can you add a note to the recruiter playbook about the temporary UI mapping?

omar: apply complete. job=114456. 12 flagged. log snippet:
```
2026-02-10T08:12:02Z INFO flagged INT-3011 ui_flag=teamfit_visible
```

priya: spot-checked 3 interviews, team-fit now visible in UI under "culture" section.

lina: thanks. follow-ups: 1) @frontend to revert mapping bug PR; 2) @people-ops to run a 20m refresher for interviewers tomorrow 11am; 3) add a nightly QA that alerts if any interviews have team_fit present but culture empty.

recruiting-bot: reminder created to post QA alert to #people-ops when count>5 per night.

lina: closing after frontend PR and refresher invite exist. :white_check_mark:
